rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a husband.

example.english: My husband is cooking dinner for me tonight.
example.traditional: 我老公今晚煮飯畀我食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lou5 gung1 gam1 maan5 zyu2 faan6 bei2 ngo5 sik6

rows.note: A speaker picks this polite form especially when referring to their own husband.

example.english: My husband will come and sign in person tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我先生聽日會親自嚟簽名。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sin1 saang1 ting1 jat6 wui5 can1 zi6 lai4 cim1 ming4

rows.note: This is chosen mainly in formal or written language rather than everyday conversation.

example.english: The woman attended the wedding ceremony with her husband.
example.traditional: 該名女子與丈夫一同出席婚禮。
example.jyutping: goi1 ming4 neoi5 zi2 jyu5 zoeng6 fu1 jat1 tung4 ceot1 zik6 fan1 lai5
